prerequisites: NodePool prod-app (KR001): supports only one Availability Zone: that zone running out of Spot capacity leaves the pool without nodes
NodePool prod-app (KR002): allows only 2 instance families (at least 3 recommended)
NodePool prod-app (KR003): allows only 4 instance types (AWS recommends at least 10 for Spot)

changes.action: Make the application exit on SIGTERM within the 2-minute Spot notice and lower the grace period.
changes.remediation:
Make the application exit on SIGTERM within the 2-minute Spot notice and lower the grace period.

# spec.template.spec
terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 90

changes.action: Spread the replicas across zones and nodes.
changes.remediation:
Spread the replicas across zones and nodes.

# spec.template.spec
topologySpreadConstraints:
  - maxSkew: 1
    topologyKey: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
    whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
    labelSelector:
      matchLabels:
        app: worker
  - maxSkew: 1
    topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
    whenUnsatisfiable: ScheduleAnyway
    labelSelector:
      matchLabels:
        app: worker

changes.action: Add a PodDisruptionBudget so a drain removes one replica at a time.
changes.remediation:
Add a PodDisruptionBudget so a drain removes one replica at a time.

apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: worker
  namespace: shop
spec:
  maxUnavailable: 1
  unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy: AlwaysAllow
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: worker

changes.action: Add a readinessProbe so traffic only reaches pods that can serve it. Point it at your health endpoint.
changes.remediation:
Add a readinessProbe so traffic only reaches pods that can serve it. Point it at your health endpoint.

# spec.template.spec.containers[worker]
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
  periodSeconds: 5
  failureThreshold: 3

manualReview.name: db
manualReview.reason: Persistent state detected: uses persistent volumes: zonal disks make rescheduling slower and tied to one zone
review: storage topology (zonal disks, storage class, volume binding)
replication and quorum: how many copies, and whether the rest keeps serving when one is lost
recovery time: how long a replacement pod takes to be useful again
availability zone dependency: whether the volume pins the pod to one zone
